[[Vereesa Windrunner|Vereesa]] (sister) | status = Unknown }} '''Alleria Windrunner''' was the Lead Scout and Intelligence Agent for the [[Alliance Expedition]], and the eldest of the Windrunner sisters, all of whom have served Quel'Thalas and the Alliance with distinction: [[Sylvanas Windrunner|Sylvanas]] was the Ranger-General of Silvermoon, and [[Vereesa Windrunner|Vereesa]] was a Special Ambassador. Alleria served as a ranger for the Alliance during the Second War, as the Horde burned the borderlands of Quel'Thalas. Alleria saw the evil of the Horde first hand, and was a staunch supporter of the Alliance that opposed them. At some point, Alleria had been led to believe that her sisters had died, sending her into a vengeful rage. Her thirst for vengeance caused her to create a cadre of rangers who were solely dedicated to hunting down any free orc left in Azeroth and eradicating them. Alleria hunted down the [[Bleeding Hollow clan]] whom had so far escaped capture. Alleria journeyed with the Alliance Expedition into the Orc world of Draenor, there she scouted for the Alliance forces and helped the expedition complete its mission. Alleria fought against the forces of [[Ner'zhul]] and his Shadow Horde. She fought Deathwing and later aided in defending Khadgar when he finally closed the last Dark Portal to Azeroth, after which Draenor itself was sundered in a fiery cataclysm, sacrificing her way home. Alleria, along with her surviving allies, leapt into the Twisting Nether and has not been seen since. ==Valley of Heroes Monument== {{Book||height=30em|align=left|content=Ranger Captain Alleria Windrunner Renowned Troll Hunter of [[Quel'Thalas (kingdom)|Quel'Thalas]]. Lead Scout and Intelligence Agent for the [[Alliance Expedition]] that marched into the orc homeworld of [[Draenor]]. Presumed deceased. Your heart flew straight as any arrow upon the wind, sister. You were the brightest of our Order. You were the most beloved of our kin. - [[Sylvanas Windrunner]] - Ranger General of Quel'Thalas }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Windrunner, Alleria}} [[Category:High elf characters]] [[Category:Alliance Expedition]] [[Category:Stormwind City objects]] [[Category:Readable objects]]
